nodes.label: Original App Mark
nodes.rationale: The desktop icon and favicon should use one original branch-merge mark rather than the unattributed prior favicon asset.

nodes.label: License Compliance Policy
nodes.rationale: Browsitory permits only permissively licensed dependencies, with the documented libgit2 linking-exception exception; every new dependency must be verified and recorded.

nodes.label: Design System Foundation
nodes.rationale: Build stable token, theme, icon, and primitive foundations before reskinning all consumers.

nodes.label: Design System Rollout
nodes.rationale: Apply the established visual system to remaining components only after the foundation plan has merged.

nodes.label: Visual Design System
nodes.rationale: Phase 5 creates a coherent visual system while preserving the RepoClient boundary for future VSCode-webview reuse.

nodes.label: Multi-Repo Tabs Implementation
nodes.rationale: A worker registry, per-repository frontend state, tab UI, and persistence are tightly coupled and must ship together.

nodes.label: Multi-Repo Workspaces Implementation
nodes.rationale: Saved workspace membership is a non-recursive snapshot identified by generated ID, layered over existing per-path repository tabs.

nodes.label: Multi-Repo Tab Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each open repository has an independent worker and mounted frontend state, while the tab set persists between launches.

nodes.label: Multi-Repo Workspace Architecture
nodes.rationale: Workspaces are saved named repository sets, with snapshot membership and ID-based grouping that survives restarts.

nodes.label: Layout Primitives
nodes.rationale: New independently testable layout primitives provide a stable base before layout consumers are migrated.

nodes.label: Layout Rollout
nodes.rationale: Move repository-management panels into a sidebar and transient operations into an overlay, preserving component behavior.

nodes.label: Layout Information Architecture
nodes.rationale: A nested three-pane layout prioritizes history and diffs while keeping repository-management chrome collapsed and accessible.
